Prayer: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution
 of India, praying this Court to issue a Writ of Mandamus, directing
 the first respondent herein to consider the representation of the
 petitioner, dated 01.12.2022 and consequently direct the first
 respondent to re-issue the passport (bearing No.Z5448941) in favour
 of the petitioner.
For Petitioner : Mr.T.Selvan
For R1 : Mr.P.Paulpandi
Standing Counsel  For R2 & R3 : Mr.N.Dilipkumar  Standing Counsel  ORDER
The petitioner was issued with a passport on 15.11.2019 and it expires on 14.11.2029.
Due to exhaustion of pages, the petitioner has applied for re-issuance of passport on 25.08.2022.
The passport authorities has issued a show cause notice on 20.09.2022, calling upon the petitioner to furnish his explanation with regard to the criminal case pending as against him.
On 20.09.2022, the petitioner has submitted an explanation.
However, the petitioner's application has not been considered by the passport authorities.
Hence, this petition.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

2.The learned Standing counsel appearing for the first respondent by referring the counter affidavit submits that the passport of eight passport holders including the petitioner has been kept pending in view of the criminal case in Crime No.1 of 2019 for the offences punishable under Sections 120b,
420, 465, 468, 471 of IPC r/w Section 12(1A)(a), 12 (1A)(b), 12(2) of Indian Passports Act, 1967.

The learned counsel further submits that the petitioner was arrested on 02.12.2020 under Section 104 of Customs Act, 1962 and remanded to judicial custody before the Judicial Magistrate Court, I, Trichy for smuggling of 26 numbers of foreign origin gold bars weighing 3.31 kgs worth Rs.1,56,58,730/-
from Dubai to India and a penalty of Rs.75,00,000/- was imposed upon the petitioner and the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence has proposed to launch prosecution against the petitioner under Section 135 of the Customs Act, 1962.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 3.In view of the above
, this Court is not inclined to grant any relief to this petitioner.

Accordingly,
this writ petition is dismissed.
No costs.
